changes.topic: bj-vat-gst.md: - **Reverse charge on imported services** — VAT on services supplied by a non-resident to a Benin customer is self-assessed by the recipient (reverse charge / TVA pour compte de tiers) ((approx — confirm))  _(Code Général des Impôts (Bénin) — TVA sur prestations de non-résidents)_

bj-vat-gst.md: - **VAT on foreign digital / e-services** — Benin extends VAT to electronically supplied services and digital platforms supplied to Benin consumers  _([Code Général des Impôts (Bénin) — TVA services numériques](https://www.anrok.com/vat-software-digital-services/benin))_

bj-vat-gst.md: - **Input VAT recovery** — Registered (real-regime) taxpayers may deduct input VAT on business purchases against output VAT, subject to exclusions  _(Code Général des Impôts (Bénin) — droit à déduction)_

bj-corporate-income-tax.md: - **Tax base** — Net accounting profit (per SYSCOHADA accounts) adjusted for tax add-backs and deductions  _(Code Général des Impôts (Bénin) — détermination du bénéfice imposable)_

bj-corporate-income-tax.md: - **Advance payments (acomptes)** — IS is paid by advance installments (acomptes) during the year, with the balance settled on filing ((approx — confirm number/dates of installments))  _(Code Général des Impôts (Bénin) — acomptes IS)_

bj-tax-overview.md: - **Corporate income tax (IS) annual return deadline** — By 30 April of the year following the financial year ((approx — confirm))  _(Code Général des Impôts (Bénin) — Impôt sur les Sociétés)_
